convert_stage_1_pipeline: convert a stage 1 IF text-to-image pipeline from LDM checkpoint to diffusers format
convert_super_res_pipeline: convert a stage 2 or 3 IF super resolution pipeline from LDM checkpoint to diffusers format
convert_safety_checker: convert a CLIP-based safety checker from numpy weight files to diffusers IFSafetyChecker format
convert_ldm_unet_checkpoint: convert an LDM UNet checkpoint state dict to diffusers UNet2DConditionModel format
get_super_res_unet: load and convert a super resolution UNet checkpoint from LDM format to diffusers format
